hero.subtitle: Network Engineer & Front-End Expert
hero.name: Marwan Karaga
hero.description: A Senior Front-End Developer with 4 years of experience building highly scalable web applications, FinTech systems, TravelTech platforms, F&B management tools, and high-performance corporate solutions.

ataya.name: Ataya (عطايا)
ataya.description: A comprehensive real-time auction platform operating in Saudi Arabia. I single-handedly built the entire front-end architecture, featuring low-latency live bidding via WebSockets, complex admin dashboards, and secure payment integrations.

diaarna.name: Diaarna (ديارنا)
diaarna.description: A full-scale real estate platform for the Saudi market handling sales, rentals, and installments. I designed the UI on Figma and built a complex multi-dashboard ecosystem featuring advanced financial and flexible payment modules.

smartkids.name: Smart Kids Montessori
smartkids.description: A massive educational management system built for a prestigious school network. I engineered a highly scalable admin dashboard managing thousands of students across 9 branches, featuring dynamic survey modules, complex role-based permissions, and Google Analytics integration.

mendar.name: Mendar (مندار)
mendar.description: Developed the comprehensive administrative dashboard for Mendar, a smart platform connecting users with home maintenance professionals. Built dynamic management interfaces for technicians, service categories, and users, seamlessly integrating financial tracking and real-time order status modules.

unoshop.name: UnoShop
unoshop.description: Engineered a highly customizable, multi-theme e-commerce platform. The standout feature is a robust dynamic theme builder integrated into the massive admin dashboard, allowing site owners to alter themes, UI components, colors, and layouts in real-time without touching the codebase.

payrollai.name: PayrollAI
payrollai.description: Developed a comprehensive, cross-company HR and payroll management platform deployed on Azure in just 3 months. The system features a highly complex role-based architecture, automated salary calculations, bulk Excel processing, interactive data visualization, and an internal ticketing system.

universalregister.name: Universal Register
universalregister.description: Designed and engineered a specialized maritime registration and certification platform for the UAE shipping industry. Built a secure admin dashboard featuring a multi-step verification process, automated QR code generation for document tracking, and integrated electronic signatures for issuing official certificates.

businessworld.name: Business World
businessworld.description: Designed and developed a professional, high-performance corporate landing page for Business World Holding. Focused on SEO optimization, fast loading times, and a fully responsive layout to effectively communicate the company's global presence, principles, and services.

unocode.name: UnoCode
unocode.description: Built a modern, sleek landing page for a digital tech agency specializing in software solutions. Implemented engaging UI elements, smooth scroll interactions, and a mobile-first design approach to create a compelling user experience that converts visitors into potential clients.

unomenu.name: UnoMenu
unomenu.description: Developed a comprehensive smart restaurant management and digital menu system catering to the UAE F&B sector. The platform handles complex operations including real-time order tracking, dine-in table management, takeaway, and delivery workflows. It features seamless multi-language and multi-currency support, alongside advanced financial analytics and order status filtering.

fastexpress.name: Fast Express Shipping
fastexpress.description: Developed a professional, multi-lingual corporate website for Fast Express Shipping, a logistics company based in Dubai. The platform showcases their global shipping services with a modern, responsive design, ensuring fast loading speeds and an optimized user experience for international clients.

phoenitravel.name: Phoeni Travel
phoenitravel.description: Engineered a comprehensive travel and e-visa processing platform. The system empowers admins to digitally configure visa requirements and pricing, while users apply through a highly optimized, dynamic multi-step form. Additional features include travel package bookings, event management, and a real-time customer support chat integrated via Pusher.
